people.name: Joe Vannelli
people.title: Division President, Beazer Homes Phoenix
people.source_title: Beazer Homes release: Beazer Homes Brings Solar-Included Homes to Summit at Montana Vista in Buckeye, Ariz. (archived copy of ir.beazer.com; same text in the release PDF ir.beazer.com/node/20696/pdf)
people.note: Quoted twice as 'division president for Beazer Homes in Phoenix' on the Buckeye (Summit at Montana Vista) opening. He succeeded Ryan Johnson, who was quoted as Phoenix division president in February 2024 (Beazer release) and in AZ Big Media coverage of Acacia Foothills II. ir.beazer.com returns 403 to direct requests, so the company page was read through its web.archive.org copy. Beazer's FY2025 10-K says each division is led by a regional market leader and/or an area president who reports to the CEO, but it names no one, so the line above this person is not public. Beazer became a wholly owned Dream Finders Homes subsidiary on 2026-10-20; no post-closing announcement confirms or changes this person's role.

people.title: Division President, Beazer Homes Nashville
people.note: Seen in a search snippet only, not confirmed. A web-search result summary (query: "Beazer Homes" "division president" Atlanta OR Orlando OR Charleston OR Raleigh OR Nashville ...) attributed an April 2024 community-launch release to him as Nashville division president. The release could not be opened because ir.beazer.com returns 403. He would have succeeded Geoff Hart, who was quoted as Beazer's Nashville division president in an October 2023 company release (Overlook at Aarons Cress). gaps: No leader is publicly named for these markets as of 2025-2026: Southern California (Riverside-San Bernardino), San Diego, Las Vegas, Dallas/Fort Worth, Houston, San Antonio, Indianapolis, Maryland/Baltimore, Northern Virginia/DC, Orlando, Charleston and Myrtle Beach. Beazer.com market pages, event pages and blog posts name no staff. The 2025-2026 company releases quote only the CEO and CMO, apart from the Phoenix release and the March 2026 Fisher House caption.

Area presidents / regional market leaders: Beazer's FY2025 10-K says these roles lead the divisions and report to the CEO, but no filing, company page or release opened in this run names any of them. Leads seen only on third-party directories (ZoomInfo / Yahoo Finance via search snippets; not sources, so not carried as rows): Troy Radelat and Steven Cervino (Area President), Bruce Craig (Area President), and Gary Szebalskie, Jason Oates, Shane Anthony, David Little and Christopher Gillen (Division President). None of these has a market or date attached.

Stale names not carried: Jay Thrower, named Area President for Charleston and Myrtle Beach in February 2018 (search result only, no 2025-2026 confirmation); Tim Little, named Phoenix Division President in 2014; Ed Gold, named Maryland Division President in 2012 and quoted in 2013; Ryan Johnson, Phoenix division president in 2024, succeeded by Joe Vannelli by August 2025; Geoff Hart, Nashville division president in October 2023.

Division and regional land leaders (VP / Director of Land Acquisition, Land Development, Entitlement): none are named in any public source found. Beazer's buy-or-sell-land page is a single form that names no contact. A search result showed a job posting for a 'Division Vice President of Land Acquisition' in Myrtle Beach (careerbuilder), which confirms that division-level land VP roles exist, but no name was given. The legacy iCIMS job board now redirects to careers.beazer.com / careers.dreamfindershomes.com.

Post-merger organisation: Dream Finders' closing release (2026-10-20), its Q3 2026 results release (2026-10-29) and HousingWire's integration analysis (2026-08-11) name no Beazer division or regional leaders and give no mapping of Beazer divisions into Dream Finders' Southeast / Mid-Atlantic / Midwest segments. Every row here therefore carries a pre-closing title.
Brands: Gatherings (55+ condominiums) is a product line run inside the divisions. No separate brand president was found.

HBA/BIA board rosters checked by direct URL list no Beazer person: HBA of Central Arizona, North State BIA (Sacramento), BIA Baldy View, BIA San Diego, Greater San Antonio Builders Association, Dallas Builders Association, HBA of Raleigh-Wake, HBA of Maryland, HBA of Delaware, Greater Atlanta HBA and the Greater Orlando Builders Association. The GHBA (Houston), SNHBA (Las Vegas), BAGI (Indianapolis), HBAMT (Nashville) and HBA Charleston pages blocked automated requests.

Texas Comptroller franchise-tax records (Beazer Homes Texas Holdings, Inc., Beazer Homes Texas, L.P., Beazer General Services, Inc., Beazer Fundamental, LLC) list only corporate officers (Merrill, Goldberg, Keith Belknap as General Counsel / Secretary for the 2026 report year), with no Texas division leaders.

Division presidents by market: not fully confirmed; local business journals and conference speaker lists were not checked. Beazer's 2025 community releases (Cove at Sparrows Point, MD; Belmont; Cascade) were not read and may name more division presidents.
